name: Athleta Encore Mastercard

apr.notes: Purchase, balance transfer and cash advance APR 33.49% variable (when using the Mastercard).

base_rate.description: 1X point per $1 spent everywhere else Mastercard is accepted.

rewards.redemption_notes: 500 points = $1 reward, redeemable in the Encore Market or on purchases at the Gap Inc. family of brands.

signup_bonus.description: 20% off the first purchase with the new card at Athleta.

notes: Issued by Barclays Bank Delaware. Applicants are first considered for the Athleta Encore Mastercard and, if not approved, for the Athleta Encore Credit Card usable only at Gap Inc. stores; this record covers the Mastercard. The page footnote names World Mastercard and World Elite Mastercard as trademarks without saying which package the card carries, so network_tier is recorded as none. Foreign transaction fee is not stated on the product page.
